name: Serious Stingray 77
author: yaasiinaxmed
description: Outlined pill sky-blue button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, text color changes from #0077ff to #ffffff, top becomes -30px, left becomes -30px.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Serious Stingray 77</title>
<style>
/* Serious Stingray 77 by yaasiinaxmed — https://uiverse.io/yaasiinaxmed/serious-stingray-77 */
button {
  --color: #0077ff;
  font-family: inherit;
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6em;
  height: 2.6em;
  line-height: 2.5em;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 20px;
  font-size: 17px;
  z-index: 1;
  color: var(--color);
  border: 2px solid var(--color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  position: relative;
}

button::before {
  position: absolute;
  content: "";
  background: var(--color);
  width: 150px;
  height: 200px;
  z-index: -1;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

button:hover {
  color: white;
}

button:before {
  top: 100%;
  left: 100%;
  transition: .3s all;
}

button:hover::before {
  top: -30px;
  left: -30px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
    Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
